answer: Cosignatures are collected in knoll, verified in comet, and meadow names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 14 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 1 hours of verification and 12 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
